description: This file defines a utility function 'createVoiceCallBaseConfig' that creates and returns a configuration object conforming to 'VoiceCallConfig'. The function accepts optional parameters to customize provider and tunnel provider settings and provides default values for various voice call related configurations, including webhook settings, streaming options, and TTS provider configurations.
